name: Real-Time hub left-navigation consolidation for Data Sources
description: To improve clarity and task completion in Real Time hub, we’re streamlining the left navigation. Users have reported confusion due to multiple overlapping entry points, making it difficult to locate the right actions for their real-time data workflows. By consolidating and simplifying the left-navigation menu, we aim to reduce cognitive load and help users quickly identify the most relevant entry point for their tasks.

result.nameEs: Navegación lateral de Real-Time hub unificada para orígenes de datos
